verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs cover a complete integration path (Checkout/Elements, webhooks, idempotency, sandbox testing, API keys, versioning) and generate SDKs/client libraries in multiple languages, and independent community feedback corroborates fast integration ('up and running and accepting recurring payments in less than an hour' — stripe-comm-9; docs called 'clear and concise').
